title: Second derivative formula
text: For a parametric curve, $$\frac{d2 y}{dx2}$$ is the derivative of $$\frac{dy}{dx}$$ with respect to $$t$$, divided by $$\frac{dx}{dt}$$.

title: Evaluate
text: The derivative of $$2\csc\theta$$ is $$-2\csc\theta\cot\theta$$ . Dividing by $$\sec\theta\tan\theta$$ gives $$-2\cot**3\theta$$ . At $$theta=\frac{\pi}{6}$$, $$cot(theta)=\sqrt{3}$$, so the value is $$-6\sqrt{3}$$ and the curve is concave down.
